# Lilly

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Lilly is known for her inclination to vividly recount her various physical ailments and illnesses. She appears to derive a distinct, morbid satisfaction from describing these personal aches and health troubles to others.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)_

## Traits

- takes pleasure in detailing her aches, pains, and sicknesses  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003)</sub>

_Not yet known._

## Goals

## History

Lilly spent her summer staying at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). During her time there, she was among a group of quirky fellow boarders described by [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) in a letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Lilly also developed a growing, though conflicted, affection for [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student who was preaching in the area.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_
